statements.statement: The paper has been withdrawn at the editor's request, and its full text and PDF have been replaced by the withdrawal statement.
The reason is that indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, and the reported results cannot be relied on.
The stored paper reported 2.1 °C lower mean daily peak indoor temperature and 41% fewer hours above 28 °C, from indoor air temperature logged every ten minutes.
The indoor-temperature findings, including 2.1 °C and 41%, can no longer be relied on.
In Section 2.2 the draft sets the green roof cooling effect to 2.1 °C from Okafor et al. [14], and the stored paper reported the 2.1 °C figure.
The paper has been withdrawn; the statement says records had incorrect sensor calibration and results cannot be relied on.
The Methods use is touched by the withdrawal, and the Results estimate uses the Section 2.2 parameter.
The Discussion says the result scales with the 2.1 °C reduction from Okafor, and halving it means green roofs no longer outperform reflective coatings, so the Discussion use is touched.
The impact on the draft is high.
